content:
The teacher used continuous reinforcement (daily sticker for on-time arrival) for tardiness reduction and a fixed-ratio schedule (sticker after three quizzes with >90%) for quiz performance.  
Continuous reinforcement leads to rapid learning but also rapid extinction if rewards stop, while fixed-ratio schedules produce high, steady response rates once the requirement is understood.  
The quiz performance improved more because fixed-ratio reinforcement tends to generate stronger and more persistent behavior than continuous reinforcement in many applied settings.  

Final answer: (C)
